title: Supporting Participants: Payments, Benefits, and Indirect Costs — eTraining Module
content:
Supporting Participants: Payments, Benefits, and Indirect Costs

Hello Morgan State University Faculty & Staff, In this module, we will review key post-award processes for Participant Support Costs at Morgan State University. Topics include processing stipend requests, funding travel for research participants, processing tuition and fee remission, and understanding how participant support costs relate to indirect costs. Please note that the processes detailed in this module are specific to grant-funded activities. Some of the information may also be relevant to state-funded actions; however, policy and procedural differences may apply. We strive to continuously review these lessons to provide up-to-date guidance on Morgan’s sponsored project processes. For questions related to the activities covered in this module that are not addressed in the module content, please contact the ORA Training and Communications Coordinator: Mr. Ryan Mobley, CRA, CFRA, CPRA Email: ryan.mobley@morgan.edu Phone: 443-885-4771 Thank you, ORA Training Team

Self-paced ORA eTraining module. Source: https://share.articulate.com/fLyvCDI1vSeMFtSyq2ebF

This module has 9 lessons, each a separate knowledge base entry:
1. Participant Support Costs: Key Points
2. Stipend Vs. Contract: Which is Appropriate?
3. Stipends for MSU Students
4. Stipends for External Participants
5. Student Tuition, Fees, and Health Insurance
6. Participant Travel on Awards
7. Indirect Costs and MTDC
8. Participant Support Costs Knowledge Review
9. Message from ORA
